structured_output.what_is_happening: This is an unofficial copy of 'Super Inu' (SI), not the canonical coin. The pool was created directly on PumpSwap 22 minutes ago, without a pump.fun migration. It borrows the name of the SI meme coin that pumped after Trump's Sept 22 UN remark about 'super intelligence'. Volume is heavy ($466k in 1h on a $27k market cap), with about 1,900 unique buyers against 55 sellers. The pool holds more liquidity than the market cap, and 100% of the LP is unlocked and controllable by the creator.

narrative.description: Trump said at the UN on Sept 22, 2026 that US documents will call AI 'super intelligence' (SI). That sent the Solana meme coin Super Inu (SI) up sharply, to about $14M market cap.
narrative.why_spreading: The news coverage is real (KuCoin, ChainCatcher), but it is 4 days old. Money is now spreading into copycats of the original coin.

token_connection.why_this_token: Only the shared name. This token has no socials, no profile and no link to the original SI.
token_connection.competing_tokens: The canonical SI is Caa2mca... (Stonk launch, paired with NVDAX) and/or DEW9dSN... ($12M market cap, $231k volume in 1h). Another copy, 8ALHRu..., is already dead with zero liquidity.

authenticity.evidence: 1,881 unique buyers against only 55 unique sellers is very lopsided, which fits small-wallet swarm or bot buying (packet, GeckoTerminal). GMGN shows 0 bot/degen and no snipers or bundlers, but 16.6% fresh wallets. There are no socials and no boosts. My search on the contract found nothing.
authenticity.uncertainty: X posts and private Telegram groups are invisible to me.

structural_risks: Liquidity ($38k) is larger than market cap ($27k): the pool appears to have been seeded by the dev, who can withdraw it
100% of the LP is unlocked (RugCheck marks it 'danger')
The creator holds 15.95% and GMGN flags the wallet as a rat trader
Price is already down 22% over 15 minutes from the ATH

structured_output.counterargument: The SI narrative is real, and at $27k this is a cheap copy with heavy buyer flow that could get one more speculative leg to double. GMGN shows no snipers or bundlers, and the creator's previous best token reached $237k ATH.
unknowns: Whether the creator will pull the LP
Whether a call channel is behind the buyer swarm
Any X discussion of this contract

source_coverage.notes: Because of the time limit I ran only a few searches. The news covers only the canonical SI. The packet lists no project site or socials.

structured_output.thesis: This is a copycat ticker hijack of a fading SI narrative. It has a dev-controlled, unlocked pool worth more than the market cap, a creator holding 16%, and it has already rolled over from its ATH. Rug risk is high and the chance of a 2x is low.
